name: io.github.iqaicom/mcp-discord
title: Discord
description: Discord servers: channels, messages, reactions, forums, webhooks, and moderation basics.

environmentVariables.name: DISCORD_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bot token from Discord Developer Portal.

environmentVariables.name: RESPOND_TO_MENTIONS_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Only respond when bot is mentioned.

environmentVariables.name: BLOCK_DMS
environmentVariables.description: Block direct messages to the bot.

toolsSummary.name: send_message
toolsSummary.description: Send a message to a Discord text channel.

toolsSummary.name: read_messages
toolsSummary.description: Read recent messages from a channel.

toolsSummary.name: delete_message
toolsSummary.description: Delete a channel message by ID.

toolsSummary.name: create_forum_post
toolsSummary.description: Create a new forum thread with initial content.

toolsSummary.name: reply_to_forum_post
toolsSummary.description: Post a reply in an existing forum thread.

toolsSummary.name: add_reaction
toolsSummary.description: Add one or more emoji reactions to a message.

io.sami/gallery.about: Integrates with Discord to provide capabilities including message management, channel operations, forum posts, reactions, webhooks, and server administration with automatic reconnection and rate limiting protection.
